# Scrapingbee

ScrapingBee is a web scraping API that handles headless browsers and proxy rotation, allowing developers to extract HTML from any website in a single API call.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/scrapingbee/.

## Actions

- **ScrapingBee Data Extraction** (read-only): Extract structured data from a webpage using css or xpath selectors.
- **ScrapingBee HTML Fetch** (read-only): Fetch html or screenshot via scrapingbee html api.
- **ScrapingBee Proxy Mode** (read-only): Fetch web content via scrapingbee's proxy mode.
- **ScrapingBee Stealth Proxy** (read-only): Perform stealth scraping via scrapingbee's stealth proxy mode.
- **ScrapingBee Usage Stats** (read-only): Retrieve usage statistics for your scrapingbee account.
